description_en: Queries the list of created ManifestEdit track orchestration templates by paging
description_zh: 调用本接口分页查询已创建的ManifestEdit轨道编排模板列表
name: ListManifestEditTemplate

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 30. Valid values: 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大条数。默认值：30。取值：1~200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. The value is a string in the format of page_N, where N is the page number. You can pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. If the response does not return a NextToken value, all data has been retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。首次调用时无需传入。取值为形如page_N（N为页码）的字符串；传入上一次响应返回的NextToken可获取下一页；响应未返回NextToken表示数据已读取完毕
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned for the current request
MaxResults.description_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_en: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: The position to which the current call returns. An empty value indicates that all data has been retrieved
NextToken.description_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_en: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
NextToken.title_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see [Multiple applications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）
AppId.description_zh: 应用ID。默认取值： app-1000000。使用说明，请参见[多应用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC

ModifyTime.description_en: The modification time. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format in UTC

Name.description_en: The name of the track template group

Status.description_en: The status of the template. Valid values: 1: enabled. 0: disabled
Status.description_zh: 模板状态。取值：1：启用；0：禁用

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the ManifestEdit template

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the query conditions. This parameter is optional and is not returned by default
TotalCount.description_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
TotalCount.title_en: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
TotalCount.title_zh: TotalCount本次请求条件下的数据总量，此参数为可选参数，默认可不返回
